blocks.text: Graph ki banawat badalne aur use dekhne ke liye kai operations hain. Zaroori operations yeh hain:

items: Insertion (jorna): graph mein naya vertex ya edge jorna.
Misal: transport ke map (naqsha) mein naya shehar aaye to naya vertex aur shayad nayi edges (sarkein) jurti hain.
Deletion (nikalna): graph se vertex ya edge hatana.
Misal: map se koi shehar hataya jaye to us ka vertex aur us se judi saari edges bhi hat jati hain.
Traversal: saare vertices aur edges ko systematically (ek tay tareeqe se, ek ek kar ke) dekhna. Is ke alag alag tareeqe hain:

Breadth-First Search (BFS): source (shuruati) vertex se shuru kar ke pehle us ke saare qareebi parosi dekhta hai, phir agle level par jata hai. Misal: aap shehar ke main (central) railway station par hain aur qareeb ke saare mohalle dekhna chahte hain. Pehle woh trains lete hain jo seedhe station se jurti hain aur un se pohanchne wale saare mohalle dekh lete hain. Phir un mohallon se jure agle mohalle dekhte hain, aur yeh silsila tab tak chalta hai jab tak saare pohanch wale mohalle dekh na liye jayen.
Depth-First Search (DFS): source vertex se shuru kar ke har shaakh mein jitna aage ja sake jata hai, phir wapas (backtrack) aata hai.

Misal: aap kai floors wali building dekh rahe hain. Entrance se shuru kar ke har hallway (gallery) ke aakhir tak jate hain aur kamre dekhte hain; hallway khatam ho to wapas aa kar reh jane wale kamre dekhte hain, phir agle floor par jate hain.
Searching (dhoondna): graph mein koi khaas vertex ya edge dhoondna, jaise koi shehar ya raasta jaldi dhoondna.

blocks.prompt: Kaunsa graph traversal agle level par jane se pehle kisi vertex ke saare qareebi parosi dekhta hai (MCQ 9)?

items: Graph ke operations: insert, delete, traverse (BFS, DFS), search.
